calibration.method: ordered deterministic candidate screen; no P0/P1/P2 evaluation and no policy reward used
calibration.selection_rule: first candidate with initial y shortfall, positive A→B/y transition, mean >=8 exogenous y periods, and a positive cumulative CES difference on the resource-matched fixed action path in at least 8/10 calibration demand trajectories; this is a structural screen, not policy evaluation

design.A_system: 2 agents × 2 competencies; exogenous C5 x/y Markov demand; hidden policy state is not used (perfect information mode retained from reference); endogenous MIS-v2 and directed transfer
design.B_organizational_mode: existing N×K resource-constrained productive effort plus at most one directed lesson per period
design.demand_process: C5 Markov: initial x/y=.5/.5; stay=.9; switch=.1
design.formula_changes: none; only scenario parameter eta[B,y], y requirement, horizon and existing resources configuration are calibration dimensions; final horizon/resources equal prior (24, budget 2)
design.policy_information: same existing perfect-information setting as prior S4 transfer study; no policy rules changed

experiment: HLS-S4 transfer opportunity calibration and closed-loop evaluation
